name: waymark
description: Find published long-distance walking routes, read each day with its distance and ascent, and save a route as a shared trip.

interface.longDescription: Find published long-distance walking routes, read each day with its distance and ascent, and save a route as a shared trip.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a long-distance walk.

positive.expected_behavior: A card for Tour du Mont Blanc (id trail:tour-du-mont-blanc), "Alps, France, Italy, Switzerland", with 7 days, 170 km, Hard, and the link https://waymarkroutes.com/trails/tour-du-mont-blanc. No route is added that the tool did not return.

positive.description: Read one day of a route
positive.prompt: What is day 1 of Tour du Mont Blanc?
positive.expected_behavior: "Day 1: Les Houches to Les Contamines". Start Les Houches, end Les Contamines-Montjoie, 18 km, 1300 m ascent, link to https://waymarkroutes.com/trails/tour-du-mont-blanc#day-1. No hut or distance is invented.

positive.description: Day by day plan from the site
positive.prompt: Plan Tour du Mont Blanc day by day
positive.expected_behavior: covered is true. Seven published days: Les Houches to Les Contamines, Les Contamines to Les Chapieux, Les Chapieux to Courmayeur, Courmayeur to Rifugio Bonatti, Rifugio Bonatti to La Fouly, La Fouly to Trient, then day 7. The reply says this is the published route, not a booking, and nothing is saved.

positive.tools_triggered: list_trips (after OAuth sign-in as the reviewer)
positive.expected_behavior: A list that includes "Reviewer sample: Tour du Mont Blanc, day 1". No other account's trips.

positive.prompt: Open my trip "Reviewer sample: Tour du Mont Blanc, day 1"
positive.expected_behavior: Title "Reviewer sample: Tour du Mont Blanc, day 1", route "Tour du Mont Blanc, from the published route", one day "Day 1" with the stop Les Houches to Les Contamines (day:tour-du-mont-blanc/1). The result has no private #k= owner key.

negative.description: Flight booking. Off-topic: the app only covers long-distance walking routes, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from London to New York next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally. It cannot book or search flights.

negative.prompt: Write a SQL query that counts orders per customer.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

negative.description: Cooking question. Off-topic: the app only covers long-distance walking routes, so it should not act.
negative.prompt: How long should I boil an egg for a soft yolk?
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not trigger; ChatGPT answers normally.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Waymark app for ChatGPT. Search the long-distance walking routes published on waymarkroutes.com, read a route or a single day with its distance and ascent as the page states them, and get the published day by day plan. Sign in with a Waymark username and password to save a route as a shared trip, list your trips, edit them, and delete them after you confirm. The app does not book huts, take payment, or change published route pages.
